problems.explain: The bars mirror each other about the middle, with no tail. For symmetric data the mean and standard deviation use every value fairly. (The IQR would not be wrong, but it ignores half the data.) So the standard deviation, with the mean.

prompt.v: The histogram shows some heights of students, in inches. Which measure of spread describes it better?

options.label: The standard deviation, with the mean

problems.explain: The bars trail off to the right, and the values in that tail pull the mean and stretch the standard deviation. The IQR, built on quartiles, is not moved by them. (The same reasoning as an outlier: a few far values should not set the spread.) So the IQR, with the median.
